cover.coreProposition: Concurrent terminal conditions should use explicit consumption and arbitration state: once a generic condition has become a candidate outcome, replaying it during finalization must not erase later, more specific safety evidence, while external-effect state and the complete priority policy remain separate concerns.
cover.visualMetaphor: A bright safety marker remains fixed while a faded circular echo passes behind it and dissolves
cover.semanticObject: One sharp terminal marker protected from a repeating translucent ring
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one dominant amber marker, concentric muted blue echoes, strong negative space and a precise sense of sequence
